_description: Cell lines that are a treated or engineered version of another line in the same panel, paired with that parental line. Read off the DepMap names, which follow the convention of the parental name plus an agent and a suffix; a suffix is only accepted when every token in it names a recognised agent or marker, so unrelated lines that merely share a name prefix are not paired.

pairs.note: HCC-827-GR5 is HCC-827 after gefitinib (EGFR inhibitor), selected for resistance. The same line twice, not two lines: differences between them are the treatment, and anything they share is the background they both came from.
